tools.name: ablesign_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces this API key can use, with screen, media file and user counts. Use it to find a workspace_id. AbleSign API: GET /workspaces.

tools.name: ablesign_list_workspace_users
tools.description: List the users assigned to one workspace, with their role. AbleSign API: GET /workspaces/{id}/users.

tools.name: ablesign_list_screens
tools.description: List digital signage screens with orientation, online state, group and tags. Good first call to see the estate. AbleSign API: GET /screens.

tools.name: ablesign_get_screen
tools.description: Get one screen: resolution settings, fit mode, timezone, sync role, heartbeat time and tags. AbleSign API: GET /screens/{id}.

tools.name: ablesign_get_screen_playlist
tools.description: Get the playlist that one screen plays: its items in order, with duration, transition and schedule per item. AbleSign API: GET /screens/{id}/playlist.

tools.name: ablesign_list_screen_groups
tools.description: List screen groups (screens that share one playlist). AbleSign API: GET /screen_groups.

tools.name: ablesign_get_screen_group
tools.description: Get one screen group with its title, description and tags. AbleSign API: GET /screen_groups/{id}.

tools.name: ablesign_list_screen_group_members
tools.description: List the screens that belong to one screen group. AbleSign API: GET /screen_groups/{id}/screens.

tools.name: ablesign_list_folders
tools.description: List media folders, optionally inside one parent folder. AbleSign API: GET /folders.

tools.name: ablesign_list_media_files
tools.description: List uploaded images and videos with size, duration, dates and tags. AbleSign API: GET /media_files.

tools.name: ablesign_get_media_file
tools.description: Get one media file with its size, duration, dimensions, validity dates and tags. AbleSign API: GET /media_files/{id}.

tools.name: ablesign_list_web_apps
tools.description: List web apps (web pages shown on screens) with their validity dates and tags. AbleSign API: GET /web_apps.

tools.name: ablesign_list_proof_of_play_records
tools.description: List raw play records: how often and how long one screen played one asset in a period. The window is at most 92 days. AbleSign API: GET /proof_of_play/records.

tools.name: ablesign_summarize_plays_by_asset
tools.description: Summarize plays per asset (media file or web app): screens it played on, total plays and total seconds. Use it for 'what played most last month'. AbleSign API: GET /proof_of_play/summary.

tools.name: ablesign_summarize_asset_plays_by_screen
tools.description: Summarize how one asset (media file or web app) played on each screen: play count and total seconds per screen. AbleSign API: GET /proof_of_play/summary/screens.

tools.name: ablesign_create_folder
tools.description: WRITE: create a media folder, optionally inside a parent folder. Creates a new record on each call. AbleSign API: POST /folders.

tools.name: ablesign_rename_folder
tools.description: WRITE: change the title of one media folder. Setting the same title again changes nothing. AbleSign API: PUT /folders/{id}.

tools.name: ablesign_add_screen_playlist_items
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 50 media files or web apps to the playlist of one screen. The content plays on the live screen. Each item needs media_file_id OR web_app_id. Limit: 15 writes per minute and 30 per hour per screen. AbleSign API: POST /screens/{id}/playlist_items.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ablesign_list_web_apps · Private data: ablesign_list_workspaces, ablesign_list_media_files, ablesign_get_media_file, ablesign_list_proof_of_play_records, ablesign_summarize_plays_by_asset, ablesign_summarize_asset_plays_by_screen, ablesign_create_folder, ablesign_add_screen_playlist_items · Public sink: ablesign_list_screen_groups, ablesign_create_folder, ablesign_add_screen_playlist_items.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ablesign_list_web_apps · Private data: ablesign_list_workspaces, ablesign_list_media_files, ablesign_get_media_file, ablesign_list_proof_of_play_records, ablesign_summarize_plays_by_asset, ablesign_summarize_asset_plays_by_screen, ablesign_create_folder, ablesign_add_screen_playlist_items · Public sink: ablesign_list_screen_groups, ablesign_create_folder, ablesign_add_screen_playlist_items

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
